scope: All SS32 Claude API calls including preparation, failures, retries, input/output/cache charges; separate JEV allocation not granted
stopRule: Before each call, subtract observed charges and unresolved cost reservations from USD2; if near limit or next-call cost cannot be bounded, stop and report. Record failure/retry/cache usage and unknown charges; never reissue an unknown-completion call. The budget is not a consumption target.
